messages:
Leah Torres: quick check on the playground mock: moving the stream control to the top-right of the chat pane as a small pill (Interrupt / Regenerate). aim: reduce overlap with prompt library. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Owen Park: top-right seems discoverable on desktop, might be hard on mobile. can we collapse into the composer on small screens?
Mina Desai: agree — collapse into composer for narrow widths. accessibility: the pill must have an aria-label and a visible focus ring. also ensure its in the tab order after the composer.
Ben Harper: infra note: if we show live token count in that pill, batch updates to reduce churn. maybe update UI every 600ms and telemetry every 5s.
Leah Torres: copy suggestion: label as "Interrupt" (not "Stop") and hover text "Regenerate response" for the regen action. icon-only by default with screen-reader text.
Owen Park: UX edge: when regenerate is tapped mid-stream should we auto-abort+regen? prefer immediate abort+regen. show a tiny toast: "Regenerating..."
Mina Desai: screen reader behavior: announce only on final state — "Response complete" or "Interrupted by user". token totals should be sr-only announced after completion: "Generated 98 tokens".
Ben Harper: implementation plan: interrupt -> abort request, keep KV cache, then spawn new generation. add 300ms debounce on regen button to avoid duplicates.
Leah Torres: token counter microcopy: use approximate during streaming like "~120 tokens" then exact on finish. show small badge under prompts in the library: "Est. 45 tok".
Owen Park: motion/accessibility: token number pulse while streaming but respect prefers-reduced-motion. also ensure color contrast meets 4.5:1 for the pill background + icon.
Mina Desai: keyboard shortcuts: Esc to interrupt (but collides), add Cmd+. / Ctrl+. as alternate. surface shortcuts in tooltip and help modal.
ConsoleBot: figma update: mock saved by Leah Torres at 1769023600 (link in channel).
Leah Torres: thanks folks 44b I'll push the figma changes and loop back after a proto.
